title: Brainstorm x3w: Present design
description: Present the proposed rules-pack design in sections and obtain user approval before implementation planning.
notes:
Design section approved: add a rules subsystem; campaign binding has one base pack plus ordered add-ons; resolver validates compatibility/dependencies/explicit overrides; public lookup seam becomes provider-neutral rules records while legacy SRD exports can remain during migration.
Design section approved: persist campaign rules binding in campaign SQLite as authoritative state; CLI registry remains pointer metadata. Module packs gain rulesRequirements. createCampaign validates binding, module requirements, required packs, and provider-neutral encounter refs. Existing DBs without binding migrate/default to current D&D SRD base binding.
Design section approved: model-facing tool becomes lookup_rules using campaign binding by default; lookup_srd may remain as a compatibility wrapper. Prompt avoids D&D-only wording. Character creation dispatches by rules system, preserving D&D behavior and adding a broad level-1 Pathfinder validator backed by rules records; canonical character remains the shared projection with system-specific details in JSON.
Design section approved: rules packs reuse/generalize PackLicense policy; bundled/public rules packs require shippable policy checks; Pathfinder fixture uses ORC-licensed rules content only and avoids reserved/trademark material; campaign DB stores binding only; tests cover validation, load order, lookup routing, binding persistence, module compatibility, D&D compatibility, Pathfinder level-1 character validation, and license rejection.
close_reason: Presented design sections and received user approval for core model, binding/persistence, lookup/character creation, and licensing/testing.
